status_detail: TeraWulf announced acquisition of a hyperscale HPC development site in EastPark Industrial Park; expected to support more than 1 GW over time, with initial 500 MW ramping in H2 2028 and another 500 MW targeted for H2 2030. Site is zoned for intended use with permitting underway.
notes: EastPark is a regional industrial park created by Boyd, Carter, Elliott, Greenup, Lawrence counties and Kentucky; local reporting identifies Greenup County officials involved. County attribution may overlap Boyd/Carter depending parcel boundaries, but Greenup is directly named in local coverage.

aliases: Rubix Data Centers former AK Steel mill data center
status_detail: Rubix Data Centers proposed a hyperscale data center at the former AK Steel mill site in Russell, with up to 2 GW capacity, eight two-story buildings, and estimated $8-12 billion infrastructure investment; planning permission and power arrangements were not finalized in July 2026 reporting.
notes: News reports cite City of Russell questionnaires/answers posted by the city; direct city-hosted documents were not readily discoverable outside Facebook/social cache during rapid pass. Treat as announced/proposed, not approved.
